tools.name: status
tools.title: Prepaid notes
tools.description: How many notes the agent holds, credited and unspent, and the gateway’s tree size, spent count and anchors. Never returns note secrets. Read-only.

tools.name: deposit
tools.title: Prepay notes with one shielded deposit
tools.description: Creates `count` notes of `units` each, sends ONE shielded deposit to the gateway with memo z402:<commitment> from the agent wallet, and returns the plan id and txid. Call `claim` once it is mined. Spends real testnet funds. Refused above Z402_MAX_DEPOSIT_ZAT for one deposit, or above Z402_MAX_TOTAL_DEPOSIT_ZAT for all of them together.

tools.name: claim
tools.title: Claim a deposit
tools.description: Asks the gateway to credit the notes of a deposit (it checks the deposit with its viewing key). If the deposit is not mined yet, waits for it (up to Z402_CLAIM_WAIT_SEC, default 900 s) instead of failing.

tools.name: pay
tools.title: Fetch a paid URL
tools.description: GETs `url`; on a zec-null-402 402 it pays with a zero-knowledge proof of one unspent note of the price. No transaction per call. Talks only to Z402_GATEWAY_URL: a URL on any other origin is never fetched (no request is sent there and no redirect is followed), and only a challenge for the path requested is paid. Proves only against a root it has read itself in a recent on-chain anchor; if every note of the price was credited after the latest anchor, or the anchor is too old or not yet confirmed, waits for the gateway’s next one (up to Z402_ANCHOR_WAIT_SEC, default 900 s).
